description: Screenshot of a tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), verified account, dated March 10 2018. Trump states North Korea has not conducted a missile test since November 28, 2017, has promised not to do so through their meetings, and that he believes they will honor that commitment.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Following. North Korea has not conducted a Missile Test since November 28, 2017 and has promised not to do so through our meetings. I believe they will honor that commitment!. 1:38 PM - 10 Mar 2018

description: Black-and-white historical photograph, apparently 1930s Germany, showing two Roman Catholic clergymen in cassocks and pectoral crosses standing alongside uniformed men, all raising their right arms in the Nazi salute at an indoor gathering. The uniformed man at far right closely resembles Nazi propaganda minister Joseph Goebbels. The image is widely circulated to depict Catholic Church accommodation of the Nazi regime.
flags: Goebbels identification is by likeness and common attribution of this widely circulated photo, not by caption

description: Side-by-side comparison meme of two circular flag logos. Left: the red 1932-era Antifaschistische Aktion emblem, captioned as the '1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany'. Right: the black-and-red modern Antifascist Action logo, captioned as the '2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America'. The meme claims the modern antifa movement is a paramilitary arm of the U.S. Democratic Party.
text: 1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. 2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America. ANTIFASCIST ACTION
flags: caption claim that antifa is the paramilitary wing of the Democratic Party is an unverified partisan assertion
1933 date label is approximate; the KPD emblem dates to 1932

description: Black-and-white historical photograph of a very large outdoor rally: a dense crowd fills the frame beneath trees, with many dark flags raised. The most prominent flag carries the circular Antifaschistische Aktion emblem with its two-flag device. Consistent with a Communist Party of Germany (KPD) Antifaschistische Aktion demonstration in Germany, early 1930s. Some placards in the crowd are only partially legible.
flags: location and date inferred from the flag emblem and photo style, not shown in the image

description: Black-and-white historical photograph of a packed indoor political congress. Above the stage hangs a large banner with the circular Antifaschistische Aktion two-flag emblem, flanked by hammer-and-sickle flags and cartoon posters labeled 'So die SPD' and 'So die KPD'. A slogan banner over the podium reads 'Es lebe die rote Einheitsfront' (Long live the red united front). Consistent with the Communist Party of Germany (KPD) Antifaschistische Aktion unity congress in Berlin, July 1932.
text: So die SPD. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. So die KPD. ES LEBE DIE ROTE EINHEITSFRONT
flags: Berlin July 1932 identification inferred from banners and common attribution of this photograph, not stated in the image
